name: Jujutsu
summary: AI may help create contributions you review, understand and own; substantial AI help needs an Assisted-by trailer. Don't paste AI output or let agents post in issues, PRs or chat; translation is fine if the original text is included.

evidence.quote: You are welcome to use generative AI and LLM tools ("AI") to help create contributions as long as you review and edit what it produces to follow the project guidelines.
If a substantial part of your contribution is generated by AI, please disclose this by adding an `Assisted-by` trailer at the end of the commit message.
If you do not understand what AI has generated, please do not contribute it.
When communicating with the community, do not paste the output from AI or allow an AI agent to post for you.
It is acceptable to use AI to translate to English, but please also include your writing in its original language.

sources.title: Use of AI and LLM tools
